notes.title: Update Notes Feb 1st
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Thanks so much for all the feedback so far—it’s been really helpful! This update brings a few key improvements based on your input:

 New HUD – Important info is now closer to your car, so you can stay focused on the track.
 Slowdown Special – A new ability to help you navigate tricky sections.
 Smoother Difficulty Curve – Better pacing for new players to ease into the challenge.


Give it a try, and let me know what you think! Your feedback helps shape the game.

notes.title: Update Notes Jan 13
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
Fixed background music being permanently muted
Fixed an issue where speed meter and distance traveled would continue to increase while the game was paused

Thank You
Thank you to everyone who participated in the Playtest! Your feedback is incredibly valuable and will help us continue improving the game.
